overview.title: Tune the workspace to fit you.
overview.description: Manage system preferences, stock data providers, and AI capabilities. Unconfigured capabilities are marked as limited without blocking the rest of the app.
overview.preferencesDescription: Language and theme are persisted in PostgreSQL and shared across browsers.
overview.stockDescription: Manage FTShare and future data sources, routes, and connection checks.
overview.inferenceDescription: Choose independent providers and models for Chat and Embedding.

page.title: Give every stock a clear boundary.
page.description: Adjust model parameters per stock. The next analysis will use the new yield, position, and cash limits.

workflow.title: Choose a stock, tune its boundaries, then save once.
workflow.description: Edit one stock at a time. These settings shape future trading references; they never place orders or rewrite recorded trades.

steps.title: Choose one stock
steps.description: Each stock has its own parameters, so changes stay local.

steps.title: Read before editing
steps.description: Use decimals from 0 to 1 for ratios; 0.25 means 25%.

steps.title: Save this set once
steps.description: The bottom action saves this stock's boundaries; future references use them and recorded trades stay unchanged.

stocks.title: Choose a stock to adjust
stocks.description: Pick one stock from your portfolio and see its own model settings on the right.
stocks.tip: Each stock keeps its own model settings, so switching never overwrites another stock's boundaries.

form.title: Trading boundaries for {stock}
form.description: Read the note below each field before editing. The backend still performs the final validation when you save.
form.modelVersionHint: Marks this rule set so you can review it later.
form.effectiveDateHint: New analyses use this set from this date onward.
form.numberHint: The backend validates the exact range.
form.footerHint: Review ratios and amounts before saving; the system performs a final check.

strongBuyYieldThreshold.label: Strong-buy yield threshold
strongBuyYieldThreshold.help: At this yield, the model can mark the opportunity as a strong buy.

accumulationYieldThreshold.label: Accumulation yield threshold
accumulationYieldThreshold.help: At this yield, the model can consider a staged add.

partialTrimYieldThreshold.label: Partial-trim yield threshold
partialTrimYieldThreshold.help: In this range, the model asks you to review the position again.

aggressiveTrimYieldThreshold.label: Aggressive-trim yield threshold
aggressiveTrimYieldThreshold.help: At this boundary, the model suggests handling the position more carefully.

strongBuyBudgetRatio.label: Strong-buy budget ratio
strongBuyBudgetRatio.help: The share of this period’s budget available for a strong buy.

accumulateBudgetRatio.label: Accumulation budget ratio
accumulateBudgetRatio.help: The share of this period’s budget available for a staged add.

partialTrimRatio.label: Partial-trim ratio
partialTrimRatio.help: The reference portion to reduce for a partial trim.

aggressiveTrimRatio.label: Aggressive-trim ratio
aggressiveTrimRatio.help: The reference portion to reduce for an aggressive trim.

maxSecurityWeight.label: Maximum stock weight
maxSecurityWeight.help: Caps the highest share this stock can have in the portfolio.

maxSectorWeight.label: Maximum sector weight
maxSectorWeight.help: Caps the highest share the same sector can have in the portfolio.

cashReserveRatio.label: Cash reserve ratio
cashReserveRatio.help: The portion kept in cash and excluded from suggested buys.

maxSingleTradeAmount.label: Maximum single-trade amount
maxSingleTradeAmount.help: The most one suggested trade can use.

maxPeriodBudgetAmount.label: Maximum period budget
maxPeriodBudgetAmount.help: The most budget one analysis period can use.

transactionFeeRatio.label: Transaction fee ratio
transactionFeeRatio.help: The ratio used when estimating transaction fees.

minimumTransactionFeeAmount.label: Minimum transaction fee
minimumTransactionFeeAmount.help: Fees below this amount use the minimum estimate.

tradingLotSize.label: Trading lot size (shares)
tradingLotSize.help: Suggested share counts are rounded to this unit.

thresholds.title: Yield boundaries
thresholds.description: Decide when it is worth buying, adding in stages, or reviewing the position.

ratios.title: Budget and position
ratios.description: Control how much budget is used and how much weight a stock or sector can take.

limits.title: Trading limits
limits.description: Keep amounts, fees, and share units inside clear, easy-to-check limits.

states.readError: The stock list is temporarily unavailable.
states.parametersReadError: This stock’s model parameters are temporarily unavailable.
states.recordError: The model parameters could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
states.successMessage: The model parameters were saved. The next analysis will use the new settings.
states.emptyDescription: Complete initialization before configuring model parameters per stock.
states.noParametersTitle: This stock has no model parameters yet
states.noParametersDescription: Initialize or import its model parameters from the backend first. This page will not overwrite your settings with defaults.
states.noSummary: There are no model settings to show yet.

validation.invalid: Fix the parameters before saving. Ratios must be between 0 and 1; amounts and lot sizes cannot be negative.
